title: DBEDT Brings Business Resources to Entrepreneurs Statewide
summary: UPDATE: Due to ongoing recovery efforts taking place, the Kauai workshop that was scheduled for Oct. 1 has been postponed. New event details will be announced. The Hawaii Island events happened today, while the Maui and Oahu events are proceeding as planned.
author: David Hiromoto
